issue: Dates match lesson. Caption "completed in 1870" is true to the lesson (Rome) though Trento/Trieste came in 1918; minor.
fix: Optional: "Italy took Rome in 1870 and the German Empire was proclaimed in January 1871."

issue: Matches lesson, but in 1914 Italy stayed neutral and joined the Entente in 1915; diagram titled "in 1914" shows it as a Triple Alliance member without qualification.
fix: Title/alt: "The two blocs before 1914 (Italy stayed neutral in 1914 and joined the Entente in 1915)".

issue: Caption says months are given in the Western calendar, but "Feb 1917" and "Oct 1917" are the Julian (old style) months; Western dates are March and November. Caption contradicts the labels and the lesson.
fix: Caption: "The 1917 months follow the older Julian calendar, which is why they are called the February and October revolutions (March and November in the Western calendar)."

issue: Label "1992 Maastricht Treaty creates the European Union": treaty was signed 1992 but the EU came into being when it took effect in November 1993 (lesson says "signed in 1992, created the EU").
fix: Label: "Maastricht Treaty signed; European Union established 1993".

issue: Caption "about two years" from June 1989 to December 1991 is about two and a half years.
fix: Caption: "...took about two and a half years, from partly free elections in Poland (June 1989) to the dissolution of the Soviet Union (December 1991)."

issue: Caption "Three agreements made within two years": McMahon correspondence began July 1915 and Balfour was Nov 1917 (about 28 months); also McMahon letters and Balfour Declaration are not agreements between parties, and the lesson dates them 1916-1917.
fix: Caption: "Three commitments made between 1915 and 1917 promised different things to different parties, before the mandates settled the matter."

issue: Caption "in a state that began with an Inca civil war" is misleading: the Vilcabamba (Neo-Inca) state arose from Manco Inca rebellion c. 1536-1537, not the civil war. The lesson does not give that date.
fix: Caption: "The empire fell quickly, but a rebel Inca state at Vilcabamba held out until 1572, four decades after Cajamarca."

issue: Label puts the Angostura congress creating Gran Colombia under "Aug 1819" (Boyaca). The congress opened Feb 1819 and Gran Colombia was proclaimed in December 1819; lesson says only "that year".
fix: Label: "Boyaca (Aug): New Granada freed; Gran Colombia created at Angostura (Dec)" with when "1819".
